summary: Tokyo Lifestyle (Nasdaq: TKLF) filed a 6-K confirming completion on September 29, 2026, of a JPY568.84 million (~US$3.7 million) equity issuance: a JPY58.84 million cash subscription by Representative Director Mei Kanayama for 1,396,755 shares, and a JPY510 million debt-to-equity swap with Tokushin G.K. (his family entity) for 12,106,893 shares, extinguishing the loan receivable entirely. Post-issuance shares outstanding total 55,831,454. The board approved both transactions on September 10, 2026; no advisor or recommendation was disclosed. Structurally, this is a related-party recapitalization that dilutes existing holders while erasing insider debt. Watch for Nasdaq minimum-bid/equity compliance and any related-party governance challenges.
